headlines.title: AI 'kill switch' may need to be mandatory, Anthropic co-founder says
headlines.summary: Jack Clark says "most labs have different ways of being able to pull the plug", but says this may need to be a requirement.

headlines.title: EU halves cheap parcel influx in bid to rein in Chinese e-commerce giants
headlines.summary: The EU has cut the number of low-value parcels entering the region by half, following the introduction of a €3 flat fee. The measure is part of a broader effort to curb the growing dominance of Chinese e-commerce platforms.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: Von der Leyen U-turns, will attend landmark Carney speech
headlines.summary: Initial decision to skip Canadian prime minister's speech had raised eyebrows among EU lawmakers.

headlines.title: I got paid $5,000 to move to a place I'd never heard of
headlines.summary: Relocation schemes offer support for people who want to swap big cities for a cheaper, quieter life.

headlines.title: EU trade chief to visit Manila to finalise Philippines trade deal
headlines.summary: Manila and Brussels have already completed six rounds of talks aimed at reducing trade barriers across a broad range of sectors. The agreement would represent another step in Brussels’ efforts to diversify its trade relationships throughout the Asia-Pacific region.

headlines.title: Can Iran replace sea trade with land routes?
headlines.summary: Iran is shifting trade toward northern ports and land routes as its southern shipping faces a US blockade. Analysts say the corridors can keep essential goods moving, but cannot replace maritime trade.

headlines.title: EPA scraps climate curbs for US power generation
headlines.summary: The announcement was timed to splash down amid an energy-focused gathering of the G20 in Houston.

headlines.title: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
headlines.summary: New rules introduced on Tuesday mean establishments will be able to accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents.

headlines.title: Saudi pipeline shutdown threatens oil exports to Europe and Asia as kingdom relies on stored supplies
headlines.summary: The pipeline disruption comes as Gulf oil exports have already fallen sharply and shipping routes face further threats. With no restart date announced, the impact on deliveries to Europe and Asia depends on how long the shutdown lasts.

headlines.title: Why are European banks moving gold out of United States?
headlines.summary: The Netherlands and France have moved their gold out of US vaults. Part of the reason is fears about the reliability of the US, but equally important is the need to keep gold closer to home in the event of a crisis.

headlines.title: Gavin Newsom says he won’t run for president if Kamala Harris runs again
headlines.summary: “I don’t know if she runs but we’ll see,” Newsom told CNN in an interview posted Monday.

headlines.title: Government set to nationalise troubled steel firm
headlines.summary: Production at SSUK sites in South Yorkshire and the West Midlands was paused earlier this year.

headlines.title: Trump concedes on ethics rules, clearing the way for major crypto legislation
headlines.summary: US President Donald Trump has accepted ethics restrictions he had long resisted, removing the final obstacle to the CLARITY Act, the most significant crypto legislation ever attempted in the US, which now faces a decisive Senate vote on Tuesday.

headlines.title: India looks to steer BRICS away from anti-Western turn
headlines.summary: The BRICS summit 2026 takes place in Delhi this weekend. Unlike last year, Putin and Xi are expected to attend. Can India keep the expanded bloc united?

headlines.title: EU Parliament to open office in Canada
headlines.summary: Parliament will work in Ottawa alongside the existing EU delegation.

headlines.title: Petrol and diesel prices hit highest since 2022
headlines.summary: The cost of filling up a vehicle has rebounded, according to the RAC, as oil prices remain elevated.

headlines.title: SoftBank shares plunge as calls grow to slow AI development
headlines.summary: AI development should slow down, leading developers have warned, as the industry faces growing calls to put safety ahead of profits. The comments weighed heavily on technology shares on Monday.

headlines.title: Trump says Ukraine and Russia agreed to halt strikes on energy. Zelenskyy is not so sure.
headlines.summary: If the U.S. can make Russia stop attacking Ukraine, Kyiv will be happy to reciprocate. But Zelenskyy's not holding his breath.

headlines.title: Pubs, hotels and gyms in Wales to get 30% business rates cut
headlines.summary: The cuts comes into effect in April, but the largest businesses will pay higher rates to fund the changes.

trend_headline: 사우디 파이프라인 셧다운과 에너지 가격 급등
summary: 사우디아라비아의 파이프라인 가동 중단과 지정학적 공급 차질 여파로 유럽의 휘발유 및 디젤 가격이 2022년 이후 최고 수준으로 치솟았습니다. 이로 인해 가계의 에너지 비용 부담이 가중되며 필수 의료비와 가족 방문을 포기하는 등 실질 소비 여력이 급격히 타격을 받고 있습니다.
key_points: 사우디 파이프라인 셧다운으로 유럽 및 아시아 향 원유 수출 및 저장 물량 공급 차질 발생
영국 RAC 기준 휘발유 및 디젤 가격이 2022년 이후 최고치 기록
치솟는 에너지 및 연료비로 인해 유럽 소비자들이 의료 예약과 가족 방문까지 포기하는 극단적 절약 감행
